result.summary: A narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and buildings situated directly at the walkway edge. The roadway shows significant pavement degradation and lacks marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and patched, which can affect vehicle control and create tripping hazards for pedestrians crossing mid-block.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: A line of parked cars on the left side of the street creates sightline issues between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and uneven patches, improving safety for all users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also helping to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near any potential crossing points or intersections to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained urban sidewalk in a residential area with buildings situated directly at the walkway edge. While the sidewalk is wide and paved, it is partially obstructed by trash bins and cardboard boxes near a building entrance.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: A blue trash bin and cardboard boxes are placed on the sidewalk, narrowing the clear path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: In front of the brick building entrance in the center of the frame.

interventions.title: Clear Path Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement and enforce regulations to keep the pedestrian through-zone clear of trash receptacles and private property debris.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides. While the narrow roadway naturally limits vehicle speeds, the environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings and features significant on-street parking that may obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right side of the street can block the view of pedestrians attempting to cross, especially children.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to further reduce vehicle speeds on this narrow residential street.

result.summary: This is a narrow residential street with row houses fronting directly onto a paved sidewalk. While the environment is generally low-speed and pedestrian-oriented, the effective sidewalk width is constrained by mature trees and building stoops, and parked cars create visual obstructions between the walkway and the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parallel parked vehicles along the curb line obscure the visibility of pedestrians, particularly children, who might attempt to cross the street mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the roadway where cars are parked.

hazards.name: Narrowed Effective Walkway
hazards.description: The combination of a large mature tree and building stoops significantly narrows the clear walking path, which may impede accessibility for users with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk in front of the brick row houses.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting specifically designed to illuminate the sidewalk area to improve safety and security after dark.
